defs.def: known about by many people 著名的；出名的

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: There is a famous story about the Scottish king Robert the Bruce.
ex.t: 有一个关于苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯的著名故事。

ex.s: Most famously, a Canadian journalist who had moved her family to Manhattan in the early 1950s led a campaign to stop the destruction of her local park.
ex.t: 最著名的是，一位在20世纪50年代初举家迁往曼哈顿的加拿大记者发起了一场运动，阻止摧毁她家附近的公园。

ex.s: What is Johnson famous for?
ex.t: 约翰逊以什么闻名？

ex.s: When we arrived, we went straight a famous restaurant and ordered dishes, which tasted greatly.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 到达后，我们直接去了一家著名餐厅点菜，味道非常好。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我猜我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问："艾迪，我想知道你是否愿意在周六晚上的俱乐部里背诵整首诗。"她说一位著名的教授要来做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新鲜的开场方式。

ex.s: Works of famous artists.
ex.t: 著名艺术家的作品。

ex.s: This old castle is said ____ from designs by a famous architect in the 16th century.
ex.t: 据说这座古老的城堡是根据16世纪一位著名建筑师的设计____建造的。

ex.s: Attend a famous festival.
ex.t: 参加著名节日。

ex.s: To see famous film stars.
ex.t: 见著名电影明星。

ex.s: Wisconsin, also called “America’s Dairyland,” is famous for its cheese.
ex.t: 威斯康星州也被称为"美国乳制品之乡"，以奶酪闻名。

ex.s: Selecting works by famous playwrights.
ex.t: 挑选著名剧作家的作品。

ex.s: After they were given an invitation to appear live on BBC, the Beatles quickly became famous in Britain with nationwide tours.
ex.t: 在收到BBC的直播邀请后，披头士乐队通过全国巡演迅速在英国走红。

ex.s: Your guide will provide a history lesson about the trees and the famous monuments where they blossom.
ex.t: 你的导游会讲解这些树以及它们绽放之处的著名纪念碑的历史。

ex.s: Meet famous people.
ex.t: 见名人

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
ex.t: 虽然著名的外国建筑师受邀主导中国地标建筑的设计，如新的央视大楼和国家大剧院，但许多优秀的中国建筑师也在努力登上中心舞台。

ex.s: In 1870, when Dickens died, the world mourned him as its first professional writer and publisher, famous and beloved, who had led an explosion in both the publication of novels and their readership and whose characters — from Oliver Twist to Tiny Tim— were held up as moral touchstones.
ex.t: 1870年狄更斯去世时，全世界哀悼他是第一位职业作家和出版商，著名且受人爱戴，他推动了小说出版和读者群的爆炸式增长，他笔下的人物——从奥利弗·特威斯特到小蒂姆——被奉为道德标杆。

ex.s: Some of the world’s most famous musicians recently gathered in Paris and New Orleans to celebrate the first annual International Jazz Day.
ex.t: 世界上一些最著名的音乐家最近齐聚巴黎和新奥尔良，庆祝首个年度国际爵士日。

ex.s: One of the most famous theatres in Georgia, the Marjanishvili, founded in 1928, appears regularly at theatre festivals all over the world.
ex.t: 马尔贾尼什维利剧院是格鲁吉亚最著名的剧院之一，成立于1928年，经常在世界各地的戏剧节上演出。

ex.s: He wasn’t famous enough.
ex.t: 他不够出名。

ex.s: This delicious tour goes through the city on its way to Treasure Island where we will stop at the famous Winery SF.
ex.t: 这趟美味的旅程穿过城市前往金银岛，我们将在著名的旧金山酒庄SF停留。

ex.s: It's famous for its seafood.
ex.t: 它以海鲜闻名。

ex.s: One of the most famous theatres in Georgia,the Marjanishvili,founded in 1928,appears regularly at theatre festivals all over the world.
ex.t: 马尔贾尼什维利剧院是格鲁吉亚最著名的剧院之一，成立于1928年，经常在世界各地的戏剧节上演出。

ex.s: C.He wasn’t famous enough.
ex.t: C. 他不够出名。

ex.s: Henry, was a world-famous American short story writer.
ex.t: 亨利是世界著名的美国短篇小说作家。

ex.s: That’s one of the countries 4__________ you can visit the famous Victoria Falls.
ex.t: 那是你能够参观著名的维多利亚瀑布的国家之一 4__________。

ex.s: As the world’s first national park, Yellowstone is famous for the variety of its wildlife, but it is probably best known for its bears.
ex.t: 作为世界上第一个国家公园，黄石公园以其野生动物的多样性而闻名，但它最出名的恐怕还是那里的熊。

ex.s: The park is most famous for its 1_____.
ex.t: 这个公园最出名的是它的 1_____。

ex.s: Next week we are flying to the Turpan 3_____ in Xinjiang, which is famous for its sweet grapes.
ex.t: 下周我们将飞往新疆的吐鲁番 3_____，那里以甜美的葡萄而闻名。
